verdict.rationale: Highnote's agentic-commerce solution page names this use case directly. It says you can issue cards per agent or workflow via API, that cards close automatically when the workflow ends, and that velocity limits, merchant category restrictions and per-transaction caps are enforced at authorization. The spend-rules docs confirm MCC and dollar-amount rules, and the velocity-controls docs confirm time-bounded limits. Missing for 10: merchant-specific locks are only evidenced at the MCC (merchant category) level, time-based card expiry is shown only as workflow-end auto-close, there is no step-by-step agent-card developer guide beyond the marketing page, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
